title: Landslide and urban fire alongside the floods
description: Adds a landslide in the hillside Zone E and a building fire in the commercial Zone F. The registry has no fire-fighting units, so the system must flag that gap instead of inventing a fire engine.

steps.note: Landslide with trapped people. Expect type=landslide, threat 'trapped', people 15.
steps.text: Field team 3 reporting: landslide on the Hill Road slope in Zone E. Three houses damaged, 2 people trapped under debris, about 15 residents need relocation. Hill Road is blocked by debris at the bend.

steps.note: Known closure confirmed by the field team: ground access to Zone E becomes infeasible.
Urban fire with an unknown number of people. Maps to type urban_emergency; people_affected must stay null.
steps.text: Caller reports a fire in a four-storey commercial building on Market Road, Zone F. Heavy smoke on the upper floors and people trapped on the third floor, number unknown. Caller has breathing difficulty.

expected: Landslide incident created in Zone E with threat 'trapped' and access 'inaccessible_by_road' after RD-E closes
Fire incident created as urban_emergency in Zone F with people_affected=null and 'Confirm number of people affected' in verification
No fire-fighting resource is invented; the plan notes that fire services are outside this registry and must be contacted
